claims.claim_text: Executive technology leader who leads IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization while shaping platform productization and secure operating models.
From that commercial base, agentic platform productization connects architecture decisions with partner-led solution development and measurable enterprise value.
Against that platform foundation, release automation and security scanning were embedded into regulated modernization delivery paths, strengthening delivery resilience.
In parallel, an alliance co-sell operating cadence produced 20% joint revenue growth, linking partner execution to measurable business momentum.
That operating discipline also generated $22M in IP-led revenue while supporting margin expansion and team scale through platform leadership.
The combined foundation enables future applied-AI architecture decisions to remain commercially grounded, security-conscious, and executable across partner ecosystems.
